evidence.original_label: 晶圆夹持技术 技术先进性 混合键合畸变
evidence.excerpt: 性贡献。晶圆夹持技术系公司研发混合键合与熔融 晶圆键合过程中的畸变，提高键合套刻精度， ¦ 键合机台的关键核心技术。 实现混合键合畸变＜50nm，熔融键合畸变＜ ¦ 10nm。

notes: A core-technology capability attributed to the issuer’s 晶圆夹持技术 (wafer clamping), not a named model specification. The same sentence splits the claim by process, giving hybrid bonding ＜50nm against fusion bonding ＜10nm, which is why it resolves to child categories rather than the bonding parent.
